name: CGLS with Non-Negativity Projection
aliases: Conjugate Gradient Least Squares (CGLS) with Non-Negativity Projection
definition: An iterative method to solve the normal equations $S^T S a = S^T p$ for the coefficient vector $a$, using the CGLS variant to avoid explicitly computing $S^T S$, combined with a projection step to enforce non-negative density coefficients.
summary: CGLS with Non-Negativity Projection solves linear least squares for tomographic reconstruction by projecting the solution onto the non-negative subspace at every iteration to enforce physical validity.
